function:SDL_CopyGPUTextureToTexture.reason: Distinct checked RGBA8 2D/array textures, mip/layer regions, no scaling/cycling; uncompressed color formats and validated capability queries (docs/gpu-formats.md); BC block and cube/array transfers (docs/gpu-texture-types.md)

function:SDL_DownloadFromGPUTexture.reason: Checked RGBA8 regions, aligned staging and tightly packed owned output after fence; uncompressed color formats and validated capability queries (docs/gpu-formats.md); BC block and cube/array transfers (docs/gpu-texture-types.md)

function:SDL_CopyGPUBufferToBuffer.reason: Distinct checked data buffers; 4-aligned byte ranges, no cycling or raw copy pass

function:SDL_DownloadFromGPUBuffer.reason: Checked 4-aligned buffer range to owned readback snapshot; textures remain pending

function:SDL_SubmitGPUCommandBufferAndAc.reason: Closed native buffer download submission; fence owned by readback ticket

function:SDL_QueryGPUFence.reason: Single checked readback ticket; pending is not an error

function:SDL_WaitForGPUFences.reason: Wait for one checked readback ticket, not arbitrary fence arrays

function:SDL_ReleaseGPUFence.reason: Readback ticket owns fence; no raw fence pointer escapes

function:SDL_OpenAudioDeviceStream.reason: Default playback device only, null callback/userdata; scoped device-stream ownership, not general capture or callback support

function:SDL_GetWindowSizeInPixels.reason: Main-thread GPU camera aspect ratio from drawable pixel dimensions; zero-size fallback only

function:SDL_GPUTextureSupportsFormat.reason: Depth format selection for fixed 3D color mesh; D32/D24/D16 depth-target usage only; independent initialized RGBA8 2D/array mip/layer texture transfers (docs/gpu-texture-transfer.md); uncompressed color formats and validated capability queries (docs/gpu-formats.md)

function:SDL_BindGPUVertexBuffers.reason: Fixed vertex layouts with cycled instance buffers: model/normal stride112 or RGBA stride128; material batches bind checked byte slices, reserved step rate zero

function:SDL_BindGPUIndexBuffer.reason: Immutable copied uint32 index buffer with checked bounds; offset zero, fixed triangle-list mesh

function:SDL_PushGPUVertexUniformData.reason: Fixed 2D rows (32 bytes), 3D MVP (64 bytes), or MVP/normal columns (112 bytes), std140 vertex slot zero; no general uniform layout API

function:SDL_PushGPUFragmentUniformData.reason: Fixed 16-byte world-space light direction and ambient at fragment slot zero; no general uniform layout API

function:SDL_DrawGPUIndexedPrimitives.reason: Checked indexed draws; shared geometry/material pairs coalesce, 4096 objects / 64 groups, fixed colored-instance ABI; no general draw API

function:SDL_BindGPUFragmentSamplers.reason: Bounded immutable float4 x/y/u/v triangle mesh and copied packed RGBA8 texture; closed upload/draw, nearest sampler, no native handles exposed

function:SDL_CreateGPUShader.reason: Trusted precompiled SPIR-V/DXIL: vertex-ID zero-resource triangle or fixed position/UV mesh with one fragment sampler

function:SDL_ReleaseGPUShader.reason: Native RAII cleanup of temporary pipeline shaders; no script shader handle

function:SDL_CreateGPUGraphicsPipeline.reason: Trusted fixed vertex layouts, including colored instancing with depth test/write; reusable material pipeline, no general pipeline descriptor API

function:SDL_ReleaseGPUGraphicsPipeline.reason: Checked material and existing pipeline IDs; scoped/device cleanup and deferred destruction

function:SDL_GetGPUSwapchainTextureForma.reason: Internal pipeline creation/draw compatibility check; enum is not yet exposed

function:SDL_BindGPUGraphicsPipeline.reason: Closed native vertex-ID triangle frame; no render-pass handle exposed

function:SDL_DrawGPUPrimitives.reason: Triangle or immutable checked mesh vertex count; 1 instance, offsets zero; no general draw API

function:SDL_AcquireGPUCommandBuffer.reason: Closed native clear frame only; no command handle exposed

function:SDL_WaitAndAcquireGPUSwapchainT.reason: Closed native clear frame only; borrowed swapchain texture never escapes

function:SDL_BeginGPURenderPass.reason: Closed color/depth pass with resize; lit scene validates a bounded draw list before acquisition and records multiple objects against one shared depth target; no general render pass API

function:SDL_EndGPURenderPass.reason: Closed native color/depth passes, including lit scene draw lists; no script callback during recording

function:SDL_SubmitGPUCommandBuffer.reason: Closed native clear frame; command consumed even on submission failure

function:SDL_CancelGPUCommandBuffer.reason: Native clear cleanup only before a non-null swapchain texture is acquired

function:SDL_CreateTexture.reason: Only RGBA32 streaming and target textures; no general format/access binding

function:SDL_LockTexture.reason: Whole-image synchronous upload from a checked RGBA8 array; no borrowed mapping exposed

function:SDL_UnlockTexture.reason: Native cleanup within synchronous RGBA upload; no script unlock API

function:SDL_RenderReadPixels.reason: Current viewport only; returned surface owned by with_read_pixels

function:SDL_ConvertSurface.reason: RGBA32 copy only; temporary conversion surface stays native

function:SDL_LockSurface.reason: Internal lock of converted readback surface; no borrowed pixels exposed

function:SDL_UnlockSurface.reason: Internal cleanup of converted readback surface
